description: Machine-readable rebuild manifest for proven generated outputs. Categories without proof remain tracked and unsupported.
tool_versions_policy: Pin host Python 3 + numpy + Pillow; record versions at rebuild time in staging report.json.
guid_policy: Never rewrite .meta for rebuilt binaries. Metas stay tracked; only binary payloads are regenerated beside existing GUIDs.

sign_danger.notes: Byte-identical to tracked asset on 2026-11-09 validation.

asphalt_ww.notes: Procedural FFT asphalt; seed 11. Matches Ground textures byte-for-byte.

parking.notes: Albedo written as PNG (existing consumer path). Generator historically wrote parking_diff.jpg; pixels match.

facade_atlas.notes: Two clean runs match each other, but output size/content differs from current tracked atlas (4096x1536 vs 3072x1536). NOT eligible to untrack.

unsupported.grass_assets: Already gitignored; Unity ValVertWoods.Grass needs full terrain/scene — not validated in this Python sandbox.
unsupported.m_Bld_meshes: Already gitignored; produced by ValVertSetup.Build / Woods — destructive full-scene hooks, not sandboxed here.
unsupported.demfix: Editor DEM snap artefacts; not a clean reproducible product.
unsupported.snow_shells_vendor: gitignored vendor-derived; needs local Asset Store packs.
unsupported.facade_atlas_untrack: Blocked until generator matches intended existing atlas or scene is intentionally upgraded.
unsupported.unity_full_city: ValVertSetup.Build mutates scene/materials; out of scope for this milestone.
